environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic fixtures only

BIO-TEN-003-AC01.finding: The configuration models all six required modules and the Document Verify subfeatures with validated, independently selectable state.

BIO-TEN-003-AC02.finding: Face 1:N requires both the biometrics parent module and its distinct child flag; the real BIO-BIO-007 consumer fails closed unless both are enabled.

BIO-TEN-003-AC03.finding: Configuration updates are versioned, serialized per tenant and audit-gated before commit.

BIO-TEN-003-AC04.finding: Unknown state defaults disabled and Face 1:N is enforced end to end through its existing consumer. The other five modules have a fail-closed gateway but no pre-existing consuming seam; that cross-story enforcement boundary is explicitly disclosed.

BIO-TEN-003-AC05.finding: The approved tenant page is connected through TenantsPort to the real secured backend. Current LIVE browser proof is deliberately negative: a browser without actor provenance receives 401 and no false success. A positive authenticated LIVE Playwright workflow is owed when the shared web provenance bridge lands.

open_follow_up_obligations.required_action: Re-open and re-verify BIO-TEN-003 with positive authenticated LIVE Playwright: prove a provenance-bearing authorized tenant administrator can read and update feature configuration through the real browser and API servers, and confirm an unprivileged browser is denied.
open_follow_up_obligations.current_negative_proof: The real LIVE browser/API test proves a proof-less request is rejected with 401 before any read or mutation and the UI does not report false success.

final_acceptance.reason: AC01-AC04 and the disclosed AC05 boundary map to exact-commit implementation, tests, builder evidence and independent QA/security PASS reviews. Fresh executable, traceability, module-direction and secret checks pass. Acceptance preserves the mandatory positive authenticated LIVE re-verification after the shared web provenance bridge ships.
